props.text: Calendar demo — data is seeded relative to TODAY on view load. Everything is enabled: drag empty time to create, click to edit/delete, drag to move, drag the top or bottom edge to resize. Dashed lines mark shift boundaries; ↻ marks recurring occurrences (drag/edit one to detach, or pick "All events"); every change persists via one onChange script.

transforms.code:
# Evergreen demo data: seeded relative to today each time the view loads
	# (now(0) evaluates once at startup, so in-session edits stick).
	d0 = system.date.midnight(value)
	def at(n, h, m=0):
		return system.date.addMinutes(system.date.addHours(system.date.addDays(d0, n), h), m)
	def iso(d):
		return system.date.format(d, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss")
	def dstr(d):
		return system.date.format(d, "yyyy-MM-dd")
	out = []
	def ev(eid, title, s, e, cat, **kw):
		row = {"id": eid, "title": title, "start": s, "end": e, "category": cat}
		row.update(kw)
		out.append(row)
	ev("y-run", "Line 1 morning run", iso(at(-1, 8)), iso(at(-1, 12)), "ops", status="done",
		description="Completed yesterday - struck through via status='done'.")
	ev("y-cxl", "Order 1042", iso(at(-1, 13)), iso(at(-1, 14)), "ops", status="cancelled")
	ev("t-lube", "Lube round", iso(at(0, 6)), iso(at(0, 6, 30)), "maint")
	ev("t-batch", "Batch 4711 - Line 1", iso(at(0, 7, 30)), iso(at(0, 11)), "ops",
		description="Main production run of the day.")
	ev("t-line2", "Line 2 run", iso(at(0, 10)), iso(at(0, 12)), "ops",
		description="Overlaps Batch 4711 - the two pack into side-by-side lanes.")
	ev("t-standup", "Production standup", iso(at(0, 9)), iso(at(0, 9, 30)), "meeting",
		description="Daily sync in the control room.")
	ev("t-qa", "QA sample check", iso(at(0, 11, 15)), iso(at(0, 11, 45)), "quality", status="done")
	ev("t-vendor", "Vendor call", iso(at(0, 13)), iso(at(0, 13, 30)), "meeting", status="tentative")
	ev("t-filter", "Filter swap", iso(at(0, 15)), iso(at(0, 15, 45)), "maint")
	ev("t-night", "Night shift", iso(at(0, 22)), iso(at(1, 6)), "ops",
		description="Overnight run - crosses midnight into tomorrow.")
	ev("t-utc", "UTC instant 13:00Z", iso(at(0, 13)) + "Z", iso(at(0, 14, 30)) + "Z", "ops",
		description="Stored as a UTC instant - renders shifted into your local zone.")
	ev("m-chg", "Changeover to SKU-88", iso(at(1, 6)), iso(at(1, 8)), "ops")
	ev("m-pump", "Pump A service", iso(at(1, 10)), iso(at(1, 11, 30)), "maint",
		description="Scheduled preventive maintenance.")
	ev("m-down", "Planned downtime window", iso(at(1, 12)), iso(at(1, 14)), "maint",
		display="background", description="display='background' - shaded band behind events.")
	ev("a-audit", "Audit window", dstr(at(2, 0)), dstr(at(5, 0)), "quality", allDay=True,
		description="Multi-day all-day event (exclusive end).")
	ev("a-kick", "Supplier audit kickoff", iso(at(2, 9)), iso(at(2, 10)), "quality")
	return out
